name: Deep Cover
summary: Shenthul sends a promising Horde rogue to Sludge Fen to contact an agent hidden among the Venture Company. The Shattered Hand has spent a year placing Taskmaster Fizzule inside the company’s drilling grounds, where he watches their plans.

sections.title: A Spy Among Profiteers
sections.body: The Shattered Hand protects Orgrimmar’s interests through secret intelligence and assassination. For a year, its members worked to place an agent in the Venture Company’s ranks. Taskmaster Fizzule earned a place at their drilling outpost north of Sludge Fen, among the company’s mercenaries.

sections.title: Signs and Signals
sections.body: Fizzule must keep his hard-edged reputation to satisfy the Venture Company’s overseers. An unexpected visitor could bring an attack. Rogues who reach his tower must fire two flares from the signaling gun within sight, approach quietly, and give the Shattered Hand’s secret salute. Then Fizzule can share what he has learned about the company’s growing schemes.

faq.answer: Taskmaster Fizzule is a Shattered Hand agent placed inside the Venture Company north of Sludge Fen. He spent a year gaining authority among its mercenaries while watching their work and sending intelligence to Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does Fizzule attack if you do not signal him properly?
faq.answer: Fizzule keeps up the harsh manner expected of a Venture Company taskmaster. Without the two-flare signal and Shattered Hand salute, he takes an approaching stranger for a hostile intruder or rival agent and attacks to protect his disguise.

faq.q: Where is the Venture Company tower located?
faq.answer: The Venture Company tower overlooks its drilling grounds north of Sludge Fen, in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the Horde spying on the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand spies on the Venture Company because its reckless extraction, exploitation, and violence threaten Kalimdor. Recent intelligence pointed to a major scheme in the Barrens, so Shenthul called on his contact.

faq.q: What happens after making contact with Fizzule?
faq.answer: After contact, Fizzule directs the rogue to enter the nearby Venture Company tower, kill its inhabitants, including Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix, and take Zanzil's Altered Mixture to prove their worth to the guild.
The Shattered Hand is a network of rogues, spies, and assassins based in Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow. Once an infamous clan on Draenor, it now gathers intelligence for the Horde in secret.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you are taking a step from street scouting toward trusted work in the field, coordinating in secret.
As a member of the Horde, you see the Venture Company’s logging and drilling threaten Horde lands and resources in the Barrens.
